title: Missing division leads to massively deflated stored product
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  During a swap, the product of the virtual balances needs to be adjusted for the fee. This is done in the following line. (Line 286)  ```solidity _virtualBalanceProd = (_virtualBalanceProd * PRECISION)                 / _powDown(                     (_virtualBalanceX + _changeInVirtualBalanceTokenIn)                     * PRECISION,                     _wnX                     ); ```  This expression is incorrect.
